column1: # One original, pinned, native Linux BusyBox ELF copied and re-executed.
# The initial /bin/busybox is read-only CPIO; /tmp/guest-busybox does not
# exist in the archive. The binary is >64 KiB on all three architectures.
# Reproduces fixed-inode ENOSPC before page-backed tmpfs; no synthetic filler.
